desc: Characterise the reproducible runtime SMP/MM copy-on-write fault using the uninstrumented control and topology plan (217/209). Ticket 208 already faulted at two CPUs; 207 refuted a simple barrier fix. Keep maxcpus=1 for daily use. October secondary-startup improvements and KVM SEIS fixes do not establish a fix for this runtime fault. Repeat the original fresh-boot reproducer with at least four runs per variant before claiming improvement; no timing-only suppression may ship as a fix. External reporting remains deferred.
author: claude
